title: Lock calibrated signal intensity ranges for Pattern A and Pattern B T4 outputs in dedicated tests
objective: Create a dedicated test file that formally locks the calibrated signal intensity ranges for Pattern A (Contested Endorsement) and Pattern B (High-Intensity Unilateral Disclosure) T4 relational appraisal outputs. The calibration decision is: both patterns share the uniform signal shape (absorption=surface, valence=negative, arousal=low, trust_shift=mild_decrease, closeness_delta=-1, risk_delta=0, aftershock_days=0, guidance_resonance=neutral) identical to P0. This decision is already documented in docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md Sections 8.1.2 and 8.2.2. The task makes that decision executable and auditable through tests, and optionally adds missing calibration rationale prose to the contract document.
exact_scope: Create back/tests/test_p28_t6_signal_calibration.py with tests that: (1) verify Pattern A base signal field values exactly match contract Section 8.1.2; (2) verify Pattern B base signal field values exactly match contract Section 8.2.2; (3) verify P0, Pattern A, and Pattern B all emit identical base signal shapes (cross-pattern uniformity); (4) verify post-adjustment hard caps hold for both patterns under _adjust_t4 with a carried negative relational residual (closeness_delta floor=-2, trust_shift ceiling=mild_decrease); (5) verify non-qualifying attribute combinations for Pattern A and Pattern B fall through to the default positive path. If any calibration rationale prose is missing from docs/t4_negative_behavior_contract.md Section 8, add it without restructuring or removing existing content. Do not modify tick_bridge.py — both patterns are already implemented with the correct output shapes.
constraints: AppraisalSignal v1 is frozen — do not modify any field definitions in appraisal_settlement.py
T4 old deterministic path (P0: confrontation/withdrawal) is frozen — do not modify the P0 builder branch in tick_bridge.py
Do not modify tick_bridge.py at all — Pattern A and Pattern B are already implemented with the correct calibrated output shapes; only tests and optional doc prose are needed
Stage 1 deferred ticks (T3/T5/T6/T7/T8) must not be touched
Do not modify docs/vision.md or docs/road_map.md
Do not modify any file under .claude/agents/ — these are control-plane files and are strictly forbidden
Do not modify any existing passing test files
All test assertions for base signal fields must use exact equality against the documented contract values — no approximations
T4_QUALIFYING_EVENT_TYPES constant must not be changed — Pattern A and Pattern B use separate detection functions
acceptance_criteria: back/tests/test_p28_t6_signal_calibration.py exists and all tests in it pass

The file contains tests that assert Pattern A base signal: absorption=surface, valence=negative, arousal=low, trust_shift=mild_decrease, closeness_delta=-1, risk_delta=0, growth=[], aftershock_days=0, guidance_resonance=neutral
The file contains tests that assert Pattern B base signal fields are identical to Pattern A across all nine fields
The file contains a cross-pattern uniformity test that compares P0, Pattern A, and Pattern B base signals and confirms they share the same shape
The file contains tests verifying post-adjustment closeness_delta does not fall below -2 for both Pattern A and Pattern B when a carried negative relational residual is applied via _adjust_t4
The file contains tests verifying post-adjustment trust_shift does not exceed mild_decrease for both Pattern A and Pattern B when a carried negative relational residual is applied via _adjust_t4
The file contains tests verifying that non-qualifying Pattern A attribute combinations (reciprocity=mutual, reciprocity=unilateral, no reciprocity) fall through to the default positive path

The file contains tests verifying that non-qualifying Pattern B attribute combinations (intensity=low+unilateral, intensity=moderate+unilateral, intensity=high+mutual, intensity=high+contested, intensity=high only) fall through to the default positive path
All existing 454 tests continue to pass (zero regressions)
Total test count after this task is at least 462 (454 existing + at least 8 new tests)
